spells.resolution: Use the actual casting class’s school/rank/price: Enchantment rank 2/base 3 RP for Bard, Crimson Agent, Mirrorsage, Thief, Wizard or Paladin access; Divination rank 4/base 7 RP for Cleric, Ranger or Shaman access. Actual minimum class levels and repertoire still apply; paying another price does not grant the other placement. Both modes use a Charisma save. Each creature saves once at its first eligible exposure to this application, either on creation, entry or newly exposed line of effect while already geometrically inside. Success makes it unaffected by this cast for the cast’s remainder. Failure creates a communication restriction which is suppressed outside the sphere or behind total cover and resumes on eligible re-entry/exposure without another save.
spells.effect: An affected creature cannot voluntarily assert as true a proposition it currently believes false with intent to deceive. The prohibition covers speech, writing, sign and another actual language-capable communication method; it grants no new communication ability and requires no shared language with the caster. An attempted deliberate false assertion cannot be voluntarily communicated; the creature may choose a lawful statement or silence. It can refuse, remain silent, evade, omit facts, answer narrowly, use literally true misleading wording, state sincerely mistaken beliefs, identify another person’s words as a quote, or use obvious fiction/jokes/hypotheticals not presented as true facts. It need not reveal a secret or provide useful answers.
spells.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.
spells.limitations: No forced speech, objective-truth test, memory search, hidden-belief access or magical disclosure of who saved/failed/is affected is created. The affected creature recognizes its own inability only when it attempts the prohibited assertion, without learning new facts. Existing written records, earlier statements and other people’s observations are not rewritten; ordinary observable behavior remains ordinary evidence, not magical certification. The Divination placement’s behavioral restriction is not magical information acquisition, so Protection from Scrying does not itself authorize lying; independent Divination information effects retain their own protections. The Enchantment placement does not acquire Divination classification. Independent zone casts keep distinct saves, durations, concentration and exposure records; restriction does not stack magnitude, and one successful save does not defeat a different cast. No Charmed, compelled Action, hard-denial use, harm-ending clause or automatic source-rank upgrade is added. Pay a legal cast before effect resolution; failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S needs the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary-save rules. Resolve hidden eligibility after commitment without a diagnostic. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity has only its actual condition scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast, resource generation or extra action budget.
